evaluation_target.statement: Evaluate whether the service is operationally available.
evaluation_target.rationale: REQ-1 establishes service availability as the evaluation target.

phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: Service operation is the phenomenon that must be characterised to evaluate T1.

distinctions.rationale: Collapsing these situations would prevent evaluation of T1.

orrs.obligation: The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the service is available.

revalidation_conditions.condition: A lifecycle change affects service-status observability.
